integrity: The proof uses the recent source\'s exact lemniscate coefficient, shooting criterion, lower bound on \(\Omega_N\), and asymptotic law. The only new finite computation is an exact-rational interval certificate for ten small even horizons and a sixteen-cell radical enclosure proving \(\varpi<27/10\); the infinite tail is analytic.
scientific_limitations: The claim compares two stated worst-case upper guarantees on the same \(L\)-smooth convex class and initial-distance scale. It does not claim pointwise trajectory dominance, and it is restricted to even \(N\) because that is the horizon convention of the quoted OGM--OGM-G chained certificate.
title: Finite-horizon dominance of lemniscate acceleration over OGM--OGM-G chaining
